timely.label: Gas Prices
timely.line: Missouri's average for regular gas is $3.83, down 24 cents from a month ago and up $1.16 from a year ago, according to AAA, and Springfield averages $3.75. Your tank noticed.

timely.label: On This Day
timely.line: Faith Hill reached number one on the Billboard 200 with her album "Cry" in 2002. Still a crossover classic.

timely.label: TV Tonight
timely.line: NBC's comedy St. Denis Medical returns for season three on Monday, Nov. 2, with Wendi McLendon-Covey and David Alan Grier. Hospital humor, no co-pay.

timely.label: On This Day
timely.line: CBS televised The Wizard of Oz for the first time in prime time in 1956. No ruby slippers required.

timely.label: On This Day
timely.line: Shania Twain released "Come On Over" in 1997, the best-selling country album ever by a female artist in the U.S. Let's go, girls.

timely.label: On This Day
timely.line: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone premiered in London in 2001. Time for a family movie night.

timely.label: On This Day
timely.line: The Beach Boys hit No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 with "Kokomo" in 1988. Sing along, you know you will.

timely.label: Family Movie
timely.line: The animated Cat in the Hat, with Bill Hader voicing the Cat, hits theaters Friday, Nov. 6. Bring snacks, the Cat brings the chaos.

timely.label: Veterans Day
timely.line: Veterans Day is Wednesday, Nov. 11, nine days away. Plan a thank-you now.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Archery deer season ends Friday, Nov. 13, in 11 days. Last call for bowhunters.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: The November portion of firearms deer season opens Saturday, Nov. 14, in 12 days, and runs through Nov. 24. Dust off the orange vest.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Youth firearms deer season opens Friday, Nov. 27, in 25 days, and runs through Nov. 29. Kids, start practicing.

timely.label: Thanksgiving
timely.line: Thanksgiving is Thursday, Nov. 26, in 24 days. Start the pie planning.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Missouri hunters took 1,633 turkeys in the firearms portion of fall turkey season, and Laclede County tied for second with 42 birds, behind Greene County's 56. Laclede hunters know where the birds are.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Missouri hunters took 36 black bears this season out of a maximum of 60, during the Oct. 17 to 30 hunt. The bears had good manners.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Water pumping has resumed at Eagle Bluffs Conservation Area, so waterfowl hunting will be possible on opening day of the Middle Zone duck and coot season, Nov. 7. The ducks hadn't heard.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation is hosting a free field-to-freezer mentored antlerless deer hunt for ages 10 to 35 in Randolph County, Dec. 4 and 5. A good first hunt.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation is offering free November programs in the Ozark Region, including campfire cooking and fly tying. Dinner and a hobby, no cost.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit parent of a 10-year-old and a 13-year-old is considering a housewide YouTube ban because the son's feed is all Fortnite or AI slop. Plenty of parents know that struggle.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Budget Bytes has a chicken corn chowder that is creamy without cream, with smoky bacon, chicken, corn and potatoes, ready in 50 minutes and good for meal prep. Soup weather is here.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: The Kitchn has a cottage cheese pasta alla vodka that's ready in 30 minutes. Weeknight dinner, handled.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Scary Mommy rounded up 19 easy, cheap Christmas baking recipes for families who can't afford 30-ingredient desserts. Holiday magic on a budget.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Scary Mommy rounded up 16 easy Christmas recipes for feeding a crowd when the whole family descends on your house. Plan the menu before they arrive.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: NerdWallet says Americans are coordinating with friends and family to save money this holiday season. Teamwork makes the budget work.
